source: KitzSki interactive piste map data (winter.intermaps.com/kitzski/data?lang=de, the map on kitzski.at): every slope with number, name and colour (blue, red, black; ski routes stored as ski route)
lifts_source: winter.intermaps.com/kitzski/data (lifts), lift numbers removed, fetched 2026-11-24; Panoramabahn I and II written with OpenStreetMap's full names (the short name matched an unrelated Panoramabahn chair far to the north-east)
numbers_note: numbers whose pieces carry different colours are matched by name only: 21, 75, 120
lifts_note: The KitzSki map also shows Westendorf's lifts (110 to 126), which belong to the SkiWelt map; they are left off this list: Alpenrosenbahn I, Alpenrosenbahn II, Choralmbahn, Talkaserbahn, Laubkogellift, Fleidingbahn, Windaubergbahn, Gampenkogelbahn, Ki-Westbahn, Sammerlift, Schneebergbahn
runs_note: Entries the resort prints as a pair ('16 Streiteck+16a Streiteck') are stored under the first name: 16 Streiteck+16a Streiteck -> 16 Streiteck; 26 Kaser + 26a Kaser -> 26 Kaser; 27 Brunn + 27a Brunn -> 27 Brunn; 28 Silberstube+28a Silberstube -> 28 Silberstube; 29 Kasereck+29a Kasereck -> 29 Kasereck; 32 Hieslegg+32a Hieslegg -> 32 Hieslegg
same_as_note: The resort's spelling differs from the map's ('Hornköpfle', 'Standart'); the list's rating is also stored under the map's spelling (13 Hornköpfl-Süd, 6 Horn-Standard) so the map run takes it.
